questions.question: What is the definition of gross margin?
questions.expected_answer: Gross margin is the difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
acceptable_answers: revenue minus cost of goods sold
questions.evidence_span: Gross margin represents the difference between net sales and cost of sales

questions.question: What is the definition of operating income?
questions.expected_answer: Operating income is the profit from a company's core business operations, excluding interest and taxes.
questions.evidence_span: Operating income represents earnings from our business activities

questions.question: What is the definition of net income?
questions.expected_answer: Net income is the total profit of a company after all expenses, taxes, and costs have been deducted from revenue.
questions.evidence_span: Net income represents our total earnings after all expenses

questions.question: What is the definition of diluted earnings per share?
questions.expected_answer: Diluted earnings per share is net income divided by the weighted average number of shares outstanding, including potential shares from options and convertible securities.
acceptable_answers: earnings per share on diluted basis
questions.evidence_span: Diluted earnings per share is calculated using weighted average shares including dilutive effects

questions.question: What is the definition of research and development expense?
questions.expected_answer: Research and development expense represents costs incurred in developing new products, services, and technologies.
questions.evidence_span: Research and development expense includes costs for developing new products and services

questions.question: What is the definition of selling, general and administrative expense?
questions.expected_answer: Selling, general and administrative expense represents costs related to selling products and general corporate operations.
questions.evidence_span: Selling, general and administrative expense includes costs for marketing, selling, and administrative activities

questions.question: What is the definition of cloud services revenue?
questions.expected_answer: Cloud services revenue represents income from providing computing resources and services over the internet.
questions.evidence_span: Cloud services revenue includes income from Azure and other cloud offerings

questions.question: What is the definition of third-party seller services?

questions.question: What is the definition of advertising services revenue?

questions.question: What is the definition of operating margin?
questions.expected_answer: Operating margin is operating income expressed as a percentage of revenue, measuring operational efficiency.
